title: Rav Ada bar Minyomi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Ravina’s student, as in [Bava Kamma 31b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.31b.7), where he explained the teaching before Ravina; in [Chullin 5a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.5a.4) he raised a difficulty against Ravina; and there at 48b (compare [Chullin 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.49a.3)), regarding a needle found in the large duct of the liver, Huna Mar son of Rav Idi declared it terefah and Rav Ada bar Minyomi declared it kosher. They came and asked Ravina, who ruled like Rav Ada bar Minyomi. He was a judge in Nehardea, as stated explicitly in [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5).[^1]

notes.text: The needle case is in the consulted Chullin 49a. Sanhedrin gives Ada bar Minyomi as a judge of Nehardea. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=223&lang=en) cites the same folios and discusses the alternative Acha form.
